messages:
rachael: Hey team — I'm booking travel for the SF offsite + MLConf the week of May 12. Any hotel recs near SoMa that are good for small budgets? Also flight tips (red-eye vs morning)?
jae: If you can swing it, try the Hilton on 3rd. Not fancy but straight walk to the venue and conference shuttles.
miguel: +1 for hotel near 3rd. For flights, red-eye is worth it if you care about an extra evening in SF, but I'm useless next day 😆
priya: I always do red-eye to save a day and one night's room cost. Pack: eye mask + melatonin.
tom: If anyone's using points, the Marriott on 4th sometimes has decent saver availability. Book sooner than later.
lila: FYI, SFO traffic into SoMa can be 30–60m depending on time. If you're arriving midday, Lyft/Uber is ~25–35. BART is cheaper but a bit more walking with luggage.
miguel: Avoid the airport shuttle lines after late flights — I once waited 45m. Consider reserved car or a rideshare pick-up at the designated lot.
rachael: Thanks — would anyone want to coordinate on group bookings to save on cabs? I can make a shared doc. @here
priya: I'm in for splitting a Lyft from the airport if arrival times align. Post your flights here.
tom: Heads-up: conference afterparty is Tuesday. If you want to crash at the hotel, check late checkout policies or luggage storage. Most places hold bags for a fee or free.
lila: Pro tip: download venue map and check where chargers/quiet rooms are. Also bring a power bank; conference plugs are scarce.
miguel: For cheap breakfast, there's a great hole-in-the-wall on 2nd called "Bean & Byte" — strong coffee and pastries.
rachael: LOL love the name. Okay I'll draft a doc with hotel options + who wants a rideshare.
ops-bot: Reminder: submit your travel reimbursements within 30 days of travel. See Finance > Travel policy. :rotating_light:
priya: Also if anyone needs visa letters for international travel, ping me and I'll route to People Ops.
jae: Quick poll — red-eye (save day) or morning (less zombie): react with :crescent_moon: for red-eye, :sunrise: for morning flight.
rachael: Thanks all — I'll post the doc link tomorrow and try to cluster pickup times. Safe travels planning!
